name: Air Fryer Garlic Butter Prawns with Bulgur and Peppers

components.name: Garlic Butter Prawns

ingredients.name: Raw peeled and deveined large prawns

steps: Pat shrimp dry and toss with olive oil, grated garlic, lemon, salt and pepper. Set aside in fridge while preparing vegetables.
Melt measured butter in a small saucepan. Air fry shrimp at 185-190 C in one layer for 5-8 minutes until centre reaches 63 C; work in batches.
Toss cooked shrimp with melted butter, parsley and any cooked garlic juices. Never pour uncooked shrimp-contact marinade over the cooked shrimp without boiling it.
Portion shrimp, bulgur and vegetables separately into four containers. Garlic butter can be packed as a separate heated sauce; refrigerate promptly.

components.name: Bulgur Wheat

ingredients.name: Water or low-sodium stock for bulgur

steps: Rinse bulgur and simmer in 560 ml water until tender, then cover off heat for 10 minutes. For fine bulgur, soak instead using its recommended hydration ratio.

components.name: Roasted Peppers & Onion
steps: Toss raw pepper and onion with 18 ml oil; air fry at 190 C for 8-12 minutes, shaking halfway.

Cook fish and crustaceans to 63 C (145 F) or applicable local food-safety standard, and reheat cooked leftovers to 74 C. For crab cakes containing egg binder and purchased cooked crab, reheat to 74 C.
When recipe includes rice, cool rapidly and refrigerate promptly; do not leave cooked rice at room temperature.
Freeze in suitable airtight food-safe containers. Defrost in refrigerator, not on counter. Re-crisp breading in an air fryer when possible.
Do not freeze fresh avocado, uncooked tomato/cucumber/cabbage salad, or mayonnaise/yogurt-based dressing unless kitchen-tested separately.
